A tier-1 European operator: a Telecom, Media & Entertainment program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Retention offers fired monthly on campaign calendars; intent signals ignored in-quarter.
Network telemetry underused; NOC reactive to customer complaints. Voice care deflected without resolving; cost per contact climbing.

The save hub on Nexus triggers personalized offers from support tickets, usage drops and billing disputes within policy; the telemetry backbone on Forge unified probes, elements and tickets for predictive ops; and resolution-first voice AI grounded on the policy corpus now resolves top intents with context-preserving escalation.
